thread:
elena: Heads-up: Platform team is deprecating the /models.predict route in favor of responses.create in the v2 SDK. We'll return 410 for the old route after the deprecation window. Need a short migration guide, updated SDK snippets, and a changelog blurb. Target merge by Fri 22:00 PT.
sam: I can update TS snippets. Can someone paste the most common v1 snippet we have in examples?
jordan: Python here. Also will add a tiny test that asserts response['model'] contains the new id.
rita: I'll handle the curl examples and the "what to expect" paragraph (error codes + suggested fallback).
maria: I'll draft the migration guide and changelog. Should we include a recommended pattern for feature-flagging the model id so customers can swap quickly?
elena: Yes include a short section recommending environment-driven model ids and fallback to family aliases. Also note exact pinned ids will 410; family aliases will seamlessly route to the new variant.
sam: Old TS (v1) example we still have in a few spots: 
```
const out = await client.models.predict({
  model: 'open-llama-v1',
  prompt: 'Explain gradients in 2 sentences'
})
```
Proposed replacement: 
```
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'open-llama-2-compat',
  input: 'Explain gradients in 2 sentences'
})
```
I'll update both quickstarts and the snippets folder.
jordan: Python v1 -> v2: 
Old:
```
resp = client.models.predict('open-llama-v1', prompt='Summarize...')
```
New:
```
resp = client.responses.create(model='open-llama-2-compat', input='Summarize...')
```
I'll add a small snippet showing how to detect a 410 and switch to the family alias.
rita: Curl examples: 
Old:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/predict -d '{"model":"open-llama-v1","prompt":"..."}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```
New:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses -d '{"model":"open-llama-2-compat","input":"..."}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```
I'll add an example that checks for HTTP 410 and falls back to "open-llama" family alias.
maria: Migration doc draft: short steps: 1) replace models.predict -> responses.create, 2) swap pinned ids to new canonical ids, 3) watch for 410 and retry with family alias, 4) update SDK versions (v2 clients). Adding a "quick test" section showing the metadata check.
elena: Also include ops note recommending jittered exponential backoff for 429/503 during the flip window. Add a link to infra runbook.
sam: PR opened for TS snippet updates: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4210 — replaces examples and updates quickstart. Preview deployed.
jordan: PR opened for Python examples/tests: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4211 — added tests but linter flagged single quotes vs double quotes in a few sample files. I'll reformat.
rita: PR for curl + migration doc: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4212 — includes troubleshooting section and redirect note. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4212--docs.redwood.ai/migrations/v1-to-v2
docs-bot: Preview deployed  https://deploy-preview-4210--docs.redwood.ai/examples/quickstart-ts
maria: Changelog entry ready in PR 4213. Tagging @elena for approval. Also adding a short RFC link for the decision.
elena: Timeline: aim to merge all PRs by Fri 22:00 PT, publish site by Fri 23:30 PT. Deprecation window starts Mon 00:00 PT; old route will return 410 after 30 days.
sam: Quick note for SDK maintainers: add a small adapter in v2 client to surface a helpful error message when callers hit 410, including a migration link.
jordan: I'll add tests to ensure examples compile under our sample-app CI.
maria: Sidebar nav update needed to surface the migration guide under "Migration & Deprecations". Who can do that?
sam: I can update the sidebar after PR merge.
elena: Great. If anyone sees edge cases (embedded model ids in config files or infra templates), call them out in the PR review.
rita: Will add a short snippet for ops showing how to verify live traffic is hitting the family alias post-migration (curl /metrics check).
elena: Thanks everyone 680 — ping me or @maria if anything blocks.
